methods_quotes.q: COVID-19 student case rates were calculated as the average daily number of student cases during a 7-day period divided by the number of enrolled students.
COVID-19 student rates are presented with 95% CIs; rates with non-overlapping CIs were considered to be significantly different.
COVID-19 student rate ratios were calculated by dividing COVID-19 student case rates in TTS schools by those in non-TTS schools.
